description: A persona is run against an input (manual, scheduled, or event-triggered), progressing through the prompt→LLM→tool-call→output pipeline with live stage tracking and result surfacing.
name: Agent Execution

description: The ambient AI companion proactively nudges users toward next actions, answers in-app questions with contextual explain-in-cockpit overlays, creates goals autonomously, and retains long-term memory across sessions.
name: Athena Companion

description: Users securely store, manage, and rotate secrets for 130+ third-party connectors using AES-256-GCM encryption, OS keyring integration, and OAuth PKCE flows, with health-check probes validating liveness.
name: Credential Vault

description: Users wire persona executions to external events — inbound webhooks, GitHub/GitLab events, cron schedules, clipboard changes, file-system watches — with rate limiting, dead-letter inspection, and live event streaming.
name: Event-Driven Triggers

description: Operators drill into live and historical runs via execution timelines with OpenTelemetry-style span waterfalls, cost/token attribution, SLA evaluation, and aggregated analytics across all agents.
name: Execution Observability

description: Personas expose their tools as MCP-compatible endpoints for external LLM hosts, connect to SQL databases via natural-language query, and interop with GitLab CI/CD — making each persona addressable from outside the app.
name: External Protocol Integration

description: Users upload documents that are chunked, embedded via ONNX fastembed, and stored in a local SQLite-vec index, enabling semantic retrieval at execution time to ground agent responses in private data.
name: Knowledge Base Ingestion

description: Users compose personas into sequential or parallel pipelines on a visual canvas, passing outputs from one agent as inputs to the next, with chain-level failure policies and real-time status propagation.
name: Multi-Agent Orchestration

description: New users complete a guided onboarding overlay (persona coach, credential intro, appearance) and a step-tracked interactive tour that ends with a successfully executed first agent run.
name: Onboarding to First Run

description: Users build an AI agent persona from scratch or from a template — defining identity, system prompt, model, connectors, use-case cards, and output assertions — and iterate on it via the multi-tab editor.
name: Persona Authoring

description: Users author parameterized execution blueprints (recipes) with typed input schemas, play them back in a Playground with live output inspection, and version them for reuse across personas.
name: Recipe Playback

description: The engine automatically detects stalled or failed executions, classifies failure type (transient vs. permanent), applies recovery strategies (retry, skip, circuit-break), and surfaces healing alerts with root-cause summaries.
name: Self-Healing Recovery
